title: Pyongyang post-congress rally at Kim Il Sung Square
reason: Does not meet the protest definition on available evidence: participants are reported as expressing full support for and pledging implementation of Eighth Party Congress decisions; no demand is directed to the North Korean state. The article's 'large-scale' description gives no numerical attendance.
notes: 38 North’s photo caption established the Jan. 15 date and Kim Il Sung Square location but not purpose or size. The agent-opened Yonhap page displayed an AI-generated summary and photo caption; the coordinator separately inspected the original article body (turn3766view0, lines 76–98), which, relaying KCNA and Rodong Sinmun, describes supportive speeches, pledges to implement Congress decisions and implementation slogans on banners. Exclusion rests on the reported pro-policy purpose and absence of a state-directed demand, not an inference that attendance was below 50 or that participation was voluntary. No independent account, exact count, end date or event-specific state response was found.

title: Four-province joint army-civilian rallies supporting Eighth Party Congress decisions
reason: Does not meet the protest definition on available evidence: the opened contemporary report describes participants supporting Party Congress decisions and pledging to carry out the five-year plan, without a demand directed to the North Korean state. No attendance figures are reported.
notes: Yonhap's Jan. 20 English article reports rallies in North Pyongan, North Hwanghae, Jagang and South Hamkyong, cites KCNA and notes provincial party committee heads' participation. One contemporary publisher was located; the account is not independent confirmation of KCNA. Exclusion is based on the reported supportive purpose, not on treating missing attendance as proof of fewer than 50. Organizer, simultaneous participant counts, attendance voluntariness, physical end and event-specific response remain unknown. No link to the Jan. 15 Pyongyang rally is inferred.
